forward_process.v: VP: xt=alpha*x0+sigma*epsilon; 1000 linear betas1e-6..0.01; uniform discrete t; target alpha*epsilon-sigma*x0

sampler.v: Deterministic DDIM, exact NFE; x0=alpha*xt-sigma*v; x0 clamp[-1,1], consistent epsilon recomputation

loss: Valid LST mask per-record v-target MSE, equal average across records; no REPA or SNR weighting.
budget_basis: User requested batch256; retain completed first epoch batch128 and resume full validation before epoch2 batch256.
initialization: Resume model, optimizer, EMA and RNG from epoch1 batch128 checkpoint; no reinitialization
gpu_constraint: One A100-40GB, maximum one GPU job at a time, no H200.

conditioning.geography: actual crop center latitude/longitude -> sphere xyz and sin/cos at pi*[1,2,4]
conditioning.injection: each generation block: independent adaLN projections for both streams; final temperature adaLN; no metadata injected in condition encoder

hls_input.hls: B,6,224,224 unclipped reflectance; no Prithvi features or weights
hls_input.hls_valid: B,1,224,224 boolean full-resolution mask, NOT patch averages or attention mask
hls_input.coarse: B,1,224,224 existing normalized upsampled coarse LST
hls_input.noisy_target: B,1,224,224 noisy normalized fine-minus-coarse LST residual
hls_input.condition_projection: concat normalized six HLS bands, coarse LST, full pixel mask -> Conv2d(8,896,kernel=16,stride=16)

hls_scaling.reason: preserve previous input affine scaling; no pretrained encoder

parameter_alignment.reference: TimeGeoDiT from dit_timegeo_v_plan.json; excludes frozen Prithvi

checkpoint_policy: retain epoch_1.pt, epoch_2.pt, latest.pt, last.pt, best.pt, best_ema.pt, final_ema.pt; ties keep earlier epoch
selection_metric: full-val pixel-weighted RMSE Celsius at 50 NFE
